literal.prompt: Какое вещество, вырабатываемое париетальными клетками желудка, необходимо для нормального всасывания витамина B12?

literalGroups.primaryGround: NIH ODS L58 says intrinsic factor is secreted by stomach parietal cells, binds freed B12, and the complex is absorbed in distal ileum. OpenStax 23.4 L50-L52 distinguishes parietal-cell intrinsic factor from chief-cell pepsinogen; 23.6 L72,L75 grounds trypsin and secretin as real adjacent digestive compounds. Only the key matches the full cell-source and B12-absorption relation; alternatives are related GI substances with different functions.
literalGroups.locator: NIH ODS L58; OpenStax 23.4 L46-L52; OpenStax 23.6 L72,L75

literalGroups.literal: Париетальные клетки желудка выделяют внутренний фактор, который связывает витамин B12. Образовавшийся комплекс распознаётся рецепторами и всасывается преимущественно в подвздошной кишке.
literalGroups.primaryGround: NIH ODS L57-L58 describes B12 release and binding to intrinsic factor secreted by parietal cells; it states the complex is absorbed by receptor-mediated endocytosis in distal ileum.
OpenStax 23.4 identifies pepsin as a protein-digesting enzyme activated from pepsinogen by gastric acid and involved in protein digestion.

absoluteDifficulty.audienceGround: This requires a specific physiological fact: recognizing intrinsic factor as the parietal-cell protein that binds vitamin B12 for distal-ileal absorption. It is not broad adult knowledge and is unlikely to be known without biology or health-science familiarity. All alternatives are real digestive substances, not absurd choices; identifying the correct role requires topic knowledge.
